data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Belier was a god of forests and animals. Believed to be the protector of wild animals and the forests they inhabited. The name Belier carries the meaning “God of the Forest” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Belier usually hope their child will grow to embody god of the forest and live with faith, good character and purpose.
